certification_levels.cataloged: Entry point verified from primary documentation; no runtime claim.
certification_levels.tested: Protocol handshake and guard conformance fixtures pass on supported platforms.
certification_levels.certified: Official client plus agent action/observe E2E evidence is required for release.

required_evidence: malformed, oversized, duplicate-ID, and batch rejection
client config rollback and scoped-token isolation
managed enroll, verify, live revoke, and rotated re-enrollment
managed service-record and per-user credential custody

evidence: Automated protocol parser and proxy conformance: internal/acp tests cover initialize-compatible extensions, prompt and output streaming, filesystem, terminal, permission, malformed, oversized, duplicate-field, observe, action-block, and buffered-output non-leak behavior.

Automated client lifecycle conformance: cli/tests/test_cmd_acp.py covers JSONC-preserving Zed setup, least-privilege token creation, per-client contract locks, executable digest verification, surgical removal, and transaction rollback.

Manual macOS live agent test on 2026-09-11: Kiro CLI 2.21.3 completed initialize, session/new, session/prompt, streaming session/update, and Kiro extension messages through defenseclaw-acp in observe mode.

Manual macOS official-client test on 2026-09-11: isolated Zed discovered DefenseClaw · Kiro, launched the guarded entry, received the expected ACP success marker, and produced v8 audit records for zed/kiro prompt and output surfaces.
Manual deterministic action test on 2026-09-11: a blocked fs/write_text_file request produced JSON-RPC -32001, discarded buffered session output, and emitted no post-block frames.

Manual Linux managed-enterprise E2E on 2026-09-11: root-owned config and service credentials plus a mode-0600 target-user token completed action and observe runs; the gateway rejected the master bearer on ACP, rejected the ACP bearer on management routes, revoked a live bearer with HTTP 401, and rotated it on re-enrollment.

Manual native Windows managed-enterprise E2E on 2026-09-11: a dedicated NT SERVICE identity completed action and observe runs with service-SID-owned protected record/index DACLs and a target-SID-owned protected token; live revoke returned HTTP 401 and protected-directory re-enrollment rotated the credential.

Linux and Windows managed v8 evidence records client zed, agent kiro, profile managed, filesystem/terminal/permission surfaces, and distinct raw_action, effective_action, and would_block values for observe versus action.
